Team —

We finished a run vs. quota read this morning and there's a ~22% coverage shortfall for Q4 at current run-rate. I pulled the deal-level rollup (attached: gap_analysis_q4_v3.xlsx) and highlighted the top 12 deals by ARR and their current stage/probability. High level asks:

- Internal owners: please reply with firm commit numbers (USD) for any deal you intend to close this quarter by EOD 2026-09-09. If non-committal, give a best-case and realistic-case number and expected close date.
- Update stage to the canonical CRM stages (Proposal, Legal, Commit) and adjust probability where appropriate.
- Mark any deals that require finance/discount or legal escalation so we can route immediately.

Quick notes from the analysis:
- ACME-1023 (top gap): currently in Legal with two open comments; probability 60% in CRM but historical signal suggests 30-40%.
- ZEPHYR-211: in Proposal, customer procurement flagged a new security questionnaire that will push timeline if not prioritized.

External to looped stakeholders: Sara/Tim, appreciate any clarity on timing from your side. If you can confirm whether ACME is able to sign before 9/30 or needs an extension, that materially changes our coverage plan.

I've also left a short summary doc and a Drive folder with the model and assumptions: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-gap-analysis

Thanks — I know this is tight; focusing on the top 6 deals will materially move the needle.

Connor
